description: This is the entry point JavaScript file for a React frontend application. It initializes the React app by rendering the main 'App' component into the DOM element with id 'root' using ReactDOM.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering React components in the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React components into the DOM node associated with the root.
